citations.quote: I've had more attacks this summer than in the last 5 years together, the mould in the bedroom doesn't help
there's mould growing behind my wardrobe and now along the bedroom ceiling.
the underfloor heating in the living area stopped working completely
I've decided I'm going to pay my rent into the official rent deposit from next month until they repair things.
1. Mould is growing behind the wardrobe and along the bedroom ceiling.
2. The underfloor heating in the living area has stopped working.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The dated letter identifies both reported defects. Its delivery is a separate question.
The letter does not establish whether or when the landlord received it.
Dated photographs can document the visible defect and affected location.
The reported lack of action and any response, proposed work or access arrangements need documenting.
Mould is reported; dated observations at the affected location are relevant.
A heating failure is reported; request any inspection and service findings.
Increased asthma attacks are reported; documented findings should distinguish health effects from any attributed cause.
A specialist need is not mentioned, so the silence policy presumes the branch absent for planning. The technical cause remains open.
An official rent deposit is contemplated; any communicated deadline and its delivery need review before that route is assessed.
This is optional under the process.

questions: Are you currently experiencing severe breathing difficulty or another immediate health risk? If so, seek urgent medical help.
When and how was the June letter delivered, and do you have proof of receipt?
Has the landlord or caretaker responded, proposed work or requested access?
Have you already sent a written repair deadline, and if so, to whom and when?
